Quick help

Start with these checks

DetailHandoff is designed to work without an account or developer-operated cloud service.

01

Camera or photo issue

Open iPad or iPhone Settings, find DetailHandoff, and confirm Camera access is allowed. Photo imports use Apple’s system photo picker.

02

Report will not seal

Review the job workflow for any required Before or After views, findings, or customer acknowledgment that are still incomplete.

03

Moving to another device

Create a full backup from Settings, save it to a location you control, then use Restore on the destination device.

Common questions

Answers before you email

Do I need to create an account?

No. DetailHandoff does not require a login. Core job records are stored locally on your device.

Does DetailHandoff upload my customer or vehicle data?

The current app has no developer-operated backend, analytics, or advertising service. Data leaves the app when you choose to share a PDF, export photos, create a backup, or use an operating-system service. See the Privacy Policy for details.

Can I change a sealed report?

A sealed version is preserved. You can create a later revision without overwriting the earlier report history.

Can I recover a deleted job?

Deleted jobs remain in Recently Deleted for up to 30 days unless you permanently remove them sooner.

Is the report a legal inspection or damage diagnosis?

No. DetailHandoff is a documentation and handoff tool. It does not automatically identify damage or provide legal, insurance, or inspection advice.

Still need help?

Tell us what happened.

Include your device model, operating-system version, app version, and the step where the issue occurred. Do not email customer records or vehicle photos unless they are necessary.
